purpose: Teach: 翠/ギャング/ロータリー/ネイチャー/ジェーン/電撃/スパイラル/イングリッシュ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヒスイ、つまり翠色の腕輪を下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave you a jade bracelet—the color of jade, you know.
lines.style: Warm, gentle sharing of news. Opening softly with his name like checking he's listening. Matter-of-fact but tender. Slight pause before the clarification, like translating for a six-year-old.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとギャング映画のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about gangster movies.
lines.style: Bright, quick delivery. Eyes wide with the novelty of it. Eager to share something grown-up he experienced. No pause—the words tumble out. Small, genuine delight underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがロータリークラブ国際大会に出られるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to be at the Rotary Club's international conference.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful tone. A touch of quiet pride in the news. Speaking to herself a little as much as to him. Gentle pause before the main verb, like considering what it means.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとネイチャー誌の特集記事読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read an article from Nature magazine together.
lines.style: Quick, bright tempo. Lifting slightly on the revelation of what the publication was. Genuine pride that it was a real, important magazine. Unguarded delight at having done something grown-up with his dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジェーン・オースティンの映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's watching a Jane Austen film.
lines.style: Soft, reflective delivery. A hint of amusement at the choice without judgment. Speaking more to the moment than to him directly. Warm but a little distant, like noticing something about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「電撃」って漫画のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I heard a story from the manga 'Electro Blast.'
lines.style: Eager, quick delivery with slight emphasis on the manga title. Bouncing on the excitement of it. Speaking faster than his usual pace. Wants credit for having listened to something his dad chose.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「経済のスパイラル是正」のニュースを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's watching the news about the economic spiral correction.
lines.style: Calm, slightly resigned. Matter-of-fact delivery, like reporting something she's observed without judgment. A thin thread of wry affection—noticing what grown-ups are drawn to. Quiet exhale underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとイングリッシュブレックファストを楽しんだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I had English breakfast together—it was really nice.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied conclusion. Lingering on the memory of it. Soft, genuine contentment. Speaking slowly, savoring the moment as he tells it. A small, complete happiness in his voice.
